description: The file is a PHP web page that includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code to display passenger information, retrieve session and POST data, and dynamically generate passenger input rows for a bus booking application.

methods.name: addrw
methods.description: Adds rows to the passenger data table based on user input for number of passengers.

methods.name: delrw
methods.description: Deletes a row from the passenger data table based on user input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the passenger age inputs are numeric before form submission.
